tasks.short: Evaluate biomedical equipment safety, efficiency and effectiveness.

steps.what: Define actual evaluation requirements, use conditions and justified equipment test criteria
Perform actual equipment tests and record real observations and instrument outputs
outputs: actual equipment test observations and files

steps.what: Transfer actual readings into the evaluation dataset and check test identity and units
inputs: actual equipment test observations and files

steps.what: Judge actual safety, efficiency and effectiveness against the checked criteria and evidence limits
Write and check actual conclusions, exceptions and source versions in the evaluation record
Save the checked final equipment evaluation record

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} instrument imports for the actual evaluation dataset. Preserve actual tests, criteria selection, scientific judgement and evaluation-record writing; no automatic safety acceptance is designed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Some actual readings are manually transferred.
tasks.still_hard: Test coverage and translating bench performance into intended-use conclusions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise evidence gaps and clinically meaningful equipment limitations.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate reading transfer; evaluation responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native test-data imports reduce supported reading transfer while test validity and equipment acceptance remain engineer decisions.

assumptions: Boundary is evaluation through its actual record, not clinical deployment authorisation. Engineer and instruments produce equipment ID, test ID, condition, time, units and actual readings in s2; engineer checks identity and mapping in s3. Missing or unsupported fields are manually entered, not extracted free.

Native first. Provisional15 transfer share is actual re-keying, not logger runtime; existing imported data earn zero. Shares not measured. Ordinary final record checking counted in s5, no added approval ceremony. Save1 fully retained.
unknowns: Actual re-keying and native import coverage
research_questions: Can import mappings preserve equipment identity, units and test conditions?

incremental.description: Maintain instrument mappings and inspect exceptions

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final equipment evaluation record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional15 transfer units reduced60 percent saves9 minus1 upkeep=8; half eligible gives3.5. Criteria20, actual tests40, evaluation20, writing4 and save1 retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare technical reports, summaries and scientific, regulatory or patent documents.

steps.what: Find and verify actual engineering records, test results and the required document format
Choose the actual technical findings, claims, limitations and appropriate disclosure scope
Populate actual result tables, figures and traceable source references in the document template
Write the actual technical narrative for the selected report, article or submission document

loop.purpose: Draft prose expressing selected technical claims
loop.input: Checked evidence pack, selected claims and actual document requirements
loop.output: Draft technical narrative with evidence references
loop.check: Engineer verifies each technical claim and inference, actual methods and limitations; rejects fabricated results, misleading efficacy claims and altered disclosure scope.
loop.stop: Missing support or two failed revisions returns narrative to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native tables and fixed headings handle structured data first; variable explanation of selected engineering findings needs prose composition.

steps.what: Check the complete final document, sources, required disclosures and authorised destination
Save the checked final technical document in the controlled project record
Send the checked document to the authorised internal publication, regulatory or patent coordinator
outputs: delivered technical document for specialist workflow

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} result exports and {DOCS} templates first. A bounded drafting loop explains engineer-selected findings; the engineer checks the complete document before separate save and internal specialist handoff.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated evidence finding, table assembly and narrative drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native controlled templates and evidence-bounded drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate claims, uncertainty and disclosure appropriate to the document purpose.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what engineering evidence supports and what remains unproven.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated document assembly; technical responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled result exports and bounded drafting reduce technical document assembly while specialist publication, regulatory and patent decisions remain separately owned.

assumptions: Boundary is engineer preparation of reports, summaries, research articles and technical submission material through actual specialist handoff; specialist review and external filing are not removed. Source producers supply record IDs, versions, methods, units and actual results; engineer verifies in s1 and selects claims in s2. Missing inputs require manual assembly, not free extraction.

Native first. Provisional document mix and shares not measured. Actual manual table assembly only; existing exports earn zero. Draft and final QA counted in s4-s5; no added approval ceremony. Save and send1 each fully retained; no automatic regulatory or patent filing.
unknowns: Actual document mix and current native exports
research_questions: Can drafts preserve the intended claim strength and disclosure limits?

incremental.description: Maintain result mappings and audit technical narrative fidelity

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked complete final technical document
s5 checked final technical document and authorised specialist recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional source15 reduced40 saves6, table20 removed saves20, narrative24 reduced50 saves12; gross38 minus2 upkeep=36. Half eligible finding/assembly/drafting gives17. Claims20, final QA19 and actions2 unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design medical diagnostic or clinical equipment, instrumentation and procedures.

steps.what: Determine actual intended-use, biological, clinical and engineering requirements
Develop actual instrumentation, equipment or procedure concepts and make engineering design choices
Implement repeated drawing, parameter or procedure-format operations for the selected design
Perform actual design checks or bench evaluations and decide necessary design revisions
outputs: checked design and actual evaluation findings

steps.what: Write and check actual design rationale, changes, risks and source traceability
inputs: checked design and actual evaluation findings

steps.what: Save the checked design record and linked actual design version

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} design-tool reusable features or {DOCS} procedure layouts for repeated implementation work. The engineer retains requirements, actual design choices, bench work and rationale; no model chooses a clinical design.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated implementation operations within selected designs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable design features and procedure headings.
tasks.still_hard: Translating biological needs into a defensible engineering design.
tasks.human_edge: Create, test and revise concepts using actual intended-use evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive implementation; design responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reusable design features reduce repeated implementation while engineering and clinical design choices remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual design development and record, not release for patient use. Requirement producers supply actual intended use and constraints; engineer captures selected geometry, parameters or procedure steps in s2-s3. Missing values require manual design work and tests, not generated assumptions.

Native first. Provisional mix of equipment/instrument/procedure work, not measured. Only actual repeated implementation operations qualify; already configured features earn zero. All design judgement and bench evaluation retained. Save1 fully retained; ordinary record check inside writing.
unknowns: Current design tooling and repetitive operation share
research_questions: Which native reusable features preserve the selected actual design?

incremental.description: Maintain native reusable features and layouts

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked design record and exact linked design version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional15 implementation units reduced40 percent saves6 minus1 upkeep=5; half eligible repetition gives2. Requirements20, design40, bench checks20, rationale4 and save1 unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research engineering aspects of biological systems with other scientists.

steps.what: Discuss actual biological-system questions and research roles with collaborating scientists
Choose the engineering research method, protocol and analysis assumptions
Perform actual engineering research observations or experiments and capture their actual outputs
outputs: actual engineering research observations and files

steps.what: Transfer actual instrument observations into the analysis dataset and check identity and units
inputs: actual engineering research observations and files

steps.what: Analyze actual results and judge what engineering conclusions the biological evidence supports
outputs: actual engineering research conclusions and limitations

steps.what: Write and check the actual engineering contribution in the shared research record
inputs: actual engineering research conclusions and limitations

steps.what: Save the checked actual engineering research contribution

tasks.design: Test native {OTHER} instrument imports for actual research datasets. Retain interdisciplinary discussion, protocol choice, actual research, analysis and {DOCS} scientific contribution writing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Duplicate transfer of actual research readings.
tasks.human_edge: Develop and test engineering explanations with collaborating scientists.
tasks.altitude: Less data transfer; research decisions unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supported instrument imports reduce duplicate research-data entry while experiments and scientific conclusions remain researcher work.

assumptions: Boundary is focal engineer research work and actual shared contribution; collaborators' labour is not removed. Engineer and instruments capture actual sample ID, condition, time, units and readings in s3; engineer checks transfer in s4. Missing or unsupported fields are entered manually, no free extraction.

Native first. Provisional10 transfer share is actual duplicate entry, not instrument runtime; already imported data earn zero. Shares not measured. Ordinary scientific record check counted in s6, no added approval ceremony. Save1 fully retained.
research_questions: Can native import preserve actual sample and condition identity?

approvals.approved_version: s6 checked actual engineering research contribution

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional10 transfer units reduced60 percent saves6 minus1 upkeep=5; half eligible gives2. Collaboration10, protocol10, actual research40, analysis20, contribution9 and save1 unchanged.

role.altitude: Less duplicate data transfer and technical document assembly; engineering design, tests and scientific conclusions remain human.
role.ambitious_version: A biomedical engineer with traceable data and documents while retaining actual design, testing and research responsibility.
